title: What ChatGPT Knows About You But Won't Tell You
description:
Four prompts that make ChatGPT read between the lines of every conversation you have ever had with it: five things it worked out about you that you never said, the patterns in how you think and make decisions, the one thing you are in denial about, and two versions of your next five years side by side. Includes the exact settings you need switched on first.

Get the full prompt pack here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/14hnNzUCdpvIIh4_pkPhybBFQ8Q5AsJ_8ZBSg4SrYYZs/edit?usp=sharing
